snippet.title: TDS v0.1.3 (Full Playthrough)
snippet.description:
Full playthrough of my game, TDS v0.1.3.
Download the game here: https://fateindustries.itch.io/tds-v013
The full TDS OST playlist: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZU-GEIuio0Q

This game was made by me in just under 6 months using GameMaker Studio 2.

Chapters
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Windows 98 and Main Menu - 00:00
Chapter 1, Level 1 - 1:02
Chapter 1, Level 2 - 1:52
Chapter 1, Level 3 - 4:40
Chapter 2, Level 1 - 5:42
Chapter 2, Level 2 (Streets) - 7:25
Chapter 2, Level 2 (Apartments) - 8:17
Chapter 2, Level 2 (Subway Station) - 12:15
Chapter 2, Level 2 (Subway Train) - 12:47
Credits - 13:34
